description: This file defines the XAIChatConfig class, which extends the OpenAIGPTConfig class to interface with the X.AI API for chat-based large language models. It includes configuration, supported parameters, request transformation, and response handling tailored for the X.AI API, including special treatment of web search usage tracking and fixing finish reasons for tool calls.

classes.name: XAIChatConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for integrating with the X.AI API for chat models, extending OpenAIGPTConfig and adding support for X.AI-specific parameters, response transformation, and usage tracking.

methods.name: Optional[str] custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the custom LLM provider, 'xai'.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL and API key, with fallback to secret store and default XAI API base.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI-like parameters, conditionally including 'stop', 'frequency_penalty', and 'reasoning_effort' based on the model.

methods.name: bool _supports_stop_reason(self, model: str)
methods.description: Determines if the model supports stop tokens, with specific exclusions.

methods.name: bool _supports_frequency_penalty(self, model: str)
methods.description: Determines if the model supports the frequency penalty parameter.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool = False, )
methods.description: Maps custom parameter names to supported openai parameters for request preparation.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Prepares the request data, cleaning message data by removing 'name' fields and delegating to the superclass.

methods.name: None _fix_choice_finish_reason_for_tool_calls(choice: Choices)
methods.description: Adjusts the finish_reason to 'tool_calls' if the API returns an empty string and there are tool calls present.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw API response into the standard model response, fixing finish reasons for tool calls and extracting web search usage info.

methods.name: None _enhance_usage_with_xai_web_search_fields( self, model_response: ModelResponse, raw_response_json: dict )
methods.description: Extracts the number of sources used from the response JSON and updates the usage info accordingly.
